title: Charleston, WV — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Charleston, WV: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Charleston is a city in WV with a population of 48,000. West Virginia’s capital with the State Capitol, the Clay Center, and the Kanawha River. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
